function x = get_features(im, features, cell_size, cos_window,filter)
%GET_FEATURES
%   Extracts dense features from image.
%
%   X = GET_FEATURES(IM, FEATURES, CELL_SIZE)
%   Extracts features specified in struct FEATURES, from image IM. The
%   features should be densely sampled, in cells or intervals of CELL_SIZE.
%   The output has size [height in cells, width in cells, features].
%
%   To specify HOG features, set field 'hog' to true, and
%   'hog_orientations' to the number of bins.
%
%   To experiment with other features simply add them to this function
%   and include any needed parameters in the FEATURES struct. To allow
%   combinations of features, stack them with x = cat(3, x, new_feat).
%
%   Joao F. Henriques, 2014
%   http://www.isr.uc.pt/~henriques/


	if features.hog,
		%HOG features, from Piotr's Toolbox
		x = double(fhog(single(im) / 255, cell_size, features.hog_orientations));
		x(:,:,end) = [];  %remove all-zeros channel ("truncation feature")
	end
	
	if features.gray,
		%gray-level (scalar feature)
		x = double(im) / 255;
		
		x = x - mean(x(:));
    end
	if features.cnn,
        %CNN without traing
        x=double(cn(im,filter)) / 255;
        x = x - mean(x(:));
    end
    
	%process with cosine window if needed
% 	if ~isempty(cos_window),
% 		x = bsxfun(@times, x, cos_window);
% 	end
	
end

function kf = gaussian_correlation(xf, yf, sigma)
%GAUSSIAN_CORRELATION Gaussian Kernel at all shifts, i.e. kernel correlation.
%   Evaluates a Gaussian kernel with bandwidth SIGMA for all relative
%   shifts between input images X and Y, which must both be MxN. They must 
%   also be periodic (ie., pre-processed with a cosine window). The result
%   is an MxN map of responses.
%
%   Inputs and output are all in the Fourier domain.
%
%   Joao F. Henriques, 2014
%   http://www.isr.uc.pt/~henriques/
	
	N = size(xf,1) * size(xf,2);
	xx = xf(:)' * xf(:) / N;  %squared norm of x
	yy = yf(:)' * yf(:) / N;  %squared norm of y
	
	%cross-correlation term in Fourier domain
	xyf = xf .* conj(yf);
	xy = sum(real(ifft2(xyf)), 3);  %to spatial domain
	
	%calculate gaussian response for all positions, then go back to the
	%Fourier domain
	kf = fft2(exp(-1 / sigma^2 * max(0, (xx + yy - 2 * xy) / numel(xf))));

end

function labels = gaussian_shaped_labels(sigma, sz)
%GAUSSIAN_SHAPED_LABELS
%   Gaussian-shaped labels for all shifts of a sample.
%
%   LABELS = GAUSSIAN_SHAPED_LABELS(SIGMA, SZ)
%   Creates an array of labels (regression targets) for all shifts of a
%   sample of dimensions SZ. The output will have size SZ, representing
%   one label for each possible shift. The labels will be Gaussian-shaped,
%   with the peak at 0-shift (top-left element of the array), decaying
%   as the distance increases, and wrapping around at the borders.
%   The Gaussian function has spatial bandwidth SIGMA.
%
%   Joao F. Henriques, 2014
%   http://www.isr.uc.pt/~henriques/


% 	%as a simple example, the limit sigma = 0 would be a Dirac delta,
% 	%instead of a Gaussian:
% 	labels = zeros(sz(1:2));  %labels for all shifted samples
% 	labels(1,1) = magnitude;  %label for 0-shift (original sample)
	

	%evaluate a Gaussian with the peak at the center element
	[rs, cs] = ndgrid((1:sz(1)) - floor(sz(1)/2), (1:sz(2)) - floor(sz(2)/2));
	labels = exp(-0.5 / sigma^2 * (rs.^2 + cs.^2));

	%move the peak to the top-left, with wrap-around
	labels = circshift(labels, -floor(sz(1:2) / 2) + 1);

	%sanity check: make sure it's really at top-left
	assert(labels(1,1) == 1)

end

% This script downloads and extracts all videos to the path specified
% below.
%
% Joao F. Henriques, 2014
% http://www.isr.uc.pt/~henriques/


%local path where the videos will be located.
%note that if you change it here, you must also change it in RUN_TRACKER.
base_path = './data/Benchmark/';


%list of videos to download
videos = {'basketball', 'bolt', 'boy', 'car4', 'carDark', 'carScale', ...
	'coke', 'couple', 'crossing', 'david2', 'david3', 'david', 'deer', ...
	'dog1', 'doll', 'dudek', 'faceocc1', 'faceocc2', 'fish', 'fleetface', ...
	'football', 'football1', 'freeman1', 'freeman3', 'freeman4', 'girl', ...
	'ironman', 'jogging', 'jumping', 'lemming', 'liquor', 'matrix', ...
	'mhyang', 'motorRolling', 'mountainBike', 'shaking', 'singer1', ...
	'singer2', 'skating1', 'skiing', 'soccer', 'subway', 'suv', 'sylvester', ...
	'tiger1', 'tiger2', 'trellis', 'walking', 'walking2', 'woman'};


if ~exist(base_path, 'dir'),  %create if it doesn't exist already
	mkdir(base_path);
end

if ~exist('matlabpool', 'file'),
	%no parallel toolbox, use a simple 'for' to iterate
	disp('Downloading videos one by one, this may take a while.')
	disp(' ')
	
	for k = 1:numel(videos),
		disp(['Downloading and extracting ' videos{k} '...']);
		unzip(['http://cvlab.hanyang.ac.kr/tracker_benchmark/seq/' videos{k} '.zip'], base_path);
	end
	
else
	%download all videos in parallel
	disp('Downloading videos in parallel, this may take a while.')
	disp(' ')
	
	if matlabpool('size') == 0,
		matlabpool open;
    end
	parfor k = 1:numel(videos),
		disp(['Downloading and extracting ' videos{k} '...']);
		unzip(['http://cvlab.hanyang.ac.kr/tracker_benchmark/seq/' videos{k} '.zip'], base_path);
	end
end

首帧DataCube全局最大值归一，select_fliter固定f_a6/N10；每核独立randperm(20,1)作为相同正向x/y偏移，未设rng/随机种子、未限制在目标框内且无越界保护。可重复抽到相同shift，不是无放回选10个不同块；没有独立逐核L2标准化。
cn.m用convn(I,filter,'same')后只取h(:,:,1)堆叠10通道；main演示另用convn(...,'valid')，论文图/式1未定义这项谱边界取片，不能当已验证全谱卷积等价。核固定而KCF模型每帧EMA更新，不是离线训练CNN。
get_features把卷积结果除255、减全局mean；cosine窗口代码整体注释，tracker仍计算hann但默认未应用。与gaussian_correlation所注周期预处理假设不同。
Eq6/8原印的交叉项在-1/sigma²作用括号外、未显示复共轭；代码gaussian_correlation含conj、跨通道求和、除numel及max(0)，整距离乘-1/sigma²。公式和代码分别保留，不静默修正文式。
tracker调用X2Cube、main调用X2Cube2，ZIP均无这两个实现，无法只凭包完成mosaic→cube；不挪用MHT16通道或当前官网converter代替14通道历史协议。
demo为ball/basketball而非论文apple/deer/people；run_tracker默认Windows Updated Dataset/Griffith目录，loader假定HSI/groundtruth_rect.txt及四位PNG名，未给原视频/标注和校准载荷。

compute_performance_measures按xywh转中心后DP严格<20，precision_plot按Nx2且<=20；前者删NaN，后者截到共同长度并删NaN。默认单视频两者评测调用均未启用，不能证明表2使用哪个边界/聚合。
目标宽高固定，没有所读路径上的scale adaptation；large-target分支先半减pos/target但DataCube的imresize注释、末尾positions乘2，条件分支待运行。HSI表中初框尺寸均不触发sqrt(area)>=100，不能凭此说论文HSI实际出错。
FPS计时不含读图/X2Cube/全图归一/显示与循环前滤波采样；仅静态口径，不是复算1FPS。download_videos为原KCF普通OTB50下载脚本，不证明论文三HSI可得。
